## Featured Production Projects

### 1. MediMitra — AI Healthcare Triage & Workflow Automation
- **Overview**: Intelligent medical triage and hospital operational routing platform built to reduce emergency intake bottlenecks.
- **Architecture**: Next.js frontend, FastAPI backend, automated n8n workflow engine integrating patient symptom analysis, severity scoring, and emergency doctor dispatch.
- **Impact & Metrics**: 40% reduction in preliminary triage latency; zero patient drop-off in hospital simulation tests.
- **Live Demo**: https://medimitra-ai.vercel.app
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/DhruvVawhle/MediMitra-AI

### 2. PromptShield — AI Security & LLM Prompt Injection Firewall
- **Overview**: Real-time edge gateway that inspects, sanitizes, and neutralizes jailbreak attempts and adversarial prompt injections before reaching underlying foundation models.
- **Architecture**: Python, FastAPI, Hugging Face transformer models, ONNX Runtime, and Redis caching.
- **Impact & Metrics**: 99.2% adversarial prompt detection rate; sub-45ms average inspection overhead; 42% reduction in false positives.
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/DhruvVawhle/PromptShield

### 3. KrishiSaathi — Smart Agri-Tech E-Commerce & ML Yield Forecasting
- **Overview**: Full-stack agricultural commerce ecosystem connecting regional farmers directly with commercial buyers, featuring ML crop advisory and market price forecasting.
- **Architecture**: React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Python Flask ML service, Razorpay payment gateway.
- **Impact & Metrics**: Enabled 150+ simulated farmer-to-buyer transactions with zero intermediary fees; 88% yield prediction accuracy across 12 crop varieties.
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/DhruvVawhle/KrishiSaathi

### 4. CampusAI — Smart Campus Management & Notification System
- **Overview**: Autonomous campus administrative assistant facilitating real-time timetable updates, room allocations, student announcements, and department ticket routing.
- **Architecture**: Next.js, Firebase Authentication, Cloud Firestore, n8n WhatsApp/Telegram bot integrations.
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/DhruvVawhle/CampusAI

### 5. CineSense — NLP Sentiment Analysis & Review Intelligence Engine
- **Overview**: Large-scale movie review sentiment classification and topic extraction pipeline built on the 50,000-review IMDb benchmark.
- **Architecture**: Python, Scikit-Learn, TF-IDF vectorization, Logistic Regression / Bi-LSTM comparative models, Streamlit interactive dashboard.
- **Impact & Metrics**: 89.4% classification accuracy on out-of-sample review test sets.
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/DhruvVawhle/CineSense-IMDB-Sentiment-Analysis
